_comment: Ordered LLM providers, most preferred first. Copy to llm_providers.json.
The first provider that answers and has its model pulled serves the turn,
and Jarvis goes back to a more preferred one as soon as it returns.
Only two providers? OLLAMA_FALLBACK_HOST in .env covers that without
this file. When this file exists it replaces those settings entirely.
A provider is skipped only for being unreachable or missing its model:
an answer that looks wrong is never a reason to swap models mid-sentence.
